title: Prose
description: Unframed, theme-aware typography for semantic HTML such as articles, rendered Markdown and rich-text editors. The same rules ship as a Sass mixin: @use "minerva-design/prose.scss" as typography; then @include typography.prose; on your own selector.

support.notes: Native Angular: MnProse. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

api.notes: Native Angular: MnProse. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

vars.name: --prose-font-size
vars.description: Base font size of the body text

vars.name: --prose-border-color
vars.description: Color of the blockquote, table, code block and rule borders

vars.name: --prose-code-bg
vars.description: Background color of inline code and table headers

vars.name: --prose-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of code blocks (defaults to --radius-sm)

translationResources.title: Prose
translationResources.description: Unframed, theme-aware typography for semantic HTML such as articles, rendered Markdown and rich-text editors. The same rules ship as a Sass mixin: @use "minerva-design/prose.scss" as typography; then @include typography.prose; on your own selector.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Headings, paragraphs, links, lists, quotes and code share the theme tokens. Prose does not sanitize HTML.

as-child.title: Styling your own element
as-child.description: asChild applies the typography to its single child (e.g. an editor host) without a wrapper.

ProseProps.asChild: Merges the prose class onto its single child instead of rendering a wrapper

cssVars.--prose-font-size: Base font size of the body text

cssVars.--prose-radius: Corner radius of code blocks (defaults to --radius-sm)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Semantic HTML inside <minerva-prose>: headings, paragraphs, nested lists, inline code and quotes are styled, at any depth.

rich-content.title: Rendered Markdown
rich-content.description: HTML produced by a Markdown renderer or rich-text editor, with tables and code blocks. Prose does not sanitize: insert trusted HTML only.

scopes.title: Variables and shadow roots
scopes.description: --prose-* variables tune an instance; inside a shadow root the rules are injected into that root, once.

slots.default: Semantic HTML content (headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, code...).
